title: 30A Sunset Beach House Villa Infinity Panhandle Getaways
meta_description: 30A Pet Friendly Sunset Beach House Rental, Villa Infinity, located in Seacrest, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 3 bedroom 30A vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. 4 Bikes, Free round of golf daily during your stay.
description_expanded: Description Description 30A Pet Friendly Sunset Beach House Rental, Villa Infinity, located in Seacrest, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 3 bedroom 30A vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. 4 Bikes, Free round of golf daily during your stay. Traveling with a pet? Upon arrival, your pup will receive a Posh Pet Gift Pack filled with fun, beach-ready goodies. Each pack also includes a Posh Pet Photo Contest card with a QR code for easy uploads - simply share a photo of your furry friend enjoying their new gear and bandana. If your pet is featured on our website or social channels, you’ll receive special swag or exclusive discounts. Sunshine, sand, and tail-wagging adventures await! Right next to Rosemary and Alys Beach - 5 minute or less walk to your favorite boutique shops and restaurants, and steps to the beach. FEATURES * Gulf View Beach House * Pet Friendly * Large Living Area with Smart TV * Fully Equipped Kitchen with Breakfast Bar * Dining Area * Bedroom 1 - Queen Bed, TV, En Suite Bathroom * Bedroom 2 - Queen Bed, TV, En Suite Bathroom * Bedroom 3 - 1 Full Bed, 1 Twin Trundle * Full Size Washer/Dryer * Complimentary High Speed Wi-Fi * Seacrest Beach - Southside of 30A (Beachside) * Sleeps 6 Surveillance Device: There is a doorbell camera on exterior of home. ABOUT VILLAS AT SUNSET BEACH - SEACREST, FLORIDA - 30A Villas at Sunset Beach is located in Seacrest, FL and nestled between Alys Beach & Rosemary on the beachside of 30A. This location is fantastic and within steps to the beach. Guests will enjoy easy access to the community gulf front pool along with convenient access to family friendly restaurants and shopping. COMMUNITY AMENITIESGulf Front CommunityGulf Front Pool (Heated Seasonally) Community Gas GrillOutdoor Shower/Sand ManagementBeach Access Bonus***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round* 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round* 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct) PET FRIENDLY WITH STIPULATIONSWe welcome 1 small, well-trained, non-shedding dog to stay in this home. We require that your dog be completely potty trained and prefer dogs older than 2 years old. Crate Trained pups are preferred to deter mischievous behavior while you and your party are enjoying the beach. It is understood that while we do allow dogs with the mentioned stipulations any damages that occur during your stay will be charged to the credit card on file with the minimum fee being $350.00. ADDITIONAL PET FEE APPLIES & IS COLLECTED AFTER BOOKING IS MADE. INITIAL SUPPLIES UPON ARRIVALPanhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar and body wash. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom & one paper towel roll in the kitchen. All bed linens & towels are provided. We encourage guests to bring beach towels for use at the pool and beach. Read more

Extras, Services & Complimentary Items: 1 Complimentary Round of Golf Each Day (March - Oct)
